relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: 2 Hz EA bilateral stimulation on the Zusanli (ST36) and Sanyinjiao (SP6) acupressure points produced analgesic effects through the downregulation of the N-methyl-d-aspartate receptor type 2B (NR2B, NMDAR subunit)

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA was found to reduce GAT1 activity via activating the δ-opioid receptor in the PAG

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture analgesia has also been demonstrated to inhibit cytokines such as IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α and upregulate IL-10

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) in the spinal dorsal horn and the hippocampus can induce L-LTP of C-fiber potentials

key_findings: Review: acupuncture analgesia inhibits neuroglial plasticity-mediated central sensitization via glutamate down- and GABA/opioid up-regulation and cytokine/chemokine modulation.
